离开自动保存 · Esc 取消: Saves on blur · Esc to cancel
根据完整脚本设计镜头: Plan shots from the full script
删除段落，保留关联镜头；可撤销: Delete paragraph and keep linked shots (undoable)
创建文字镜头草稿，保留段落关联。多个镜头需逐个细化动作、分配台词，再制作画面。: Create text-only shot drafts linked to this paragraph. Refine each shot’s action and dialogue before making images.
修改总时长会按当前节奏分配到各段；修改单段会更新总时长。镜头和成片时间保持独立。: Changing the total distributes time across paragraphs using the current rhythm. Changing a paragraph updates the total. Shot and film timing remain independent.
每个方向是一张卡：一句话、最不可能的人、他想要什么、仪式、产品证据、最后一句、风: Each direction is a card: one line, least-likely participant, what they want, ritual, product evidence, reframe, risk. Diverge, kill, then choose.
在 Agent 里让创意策划跑 8–12 个 rough studies，再把: Ask the concept agent for 8–12 rough studies, then develop three into cards. It writes to this board; you keep, kill or select here.
先探索方向，再选中创意交给编剧。: Explore directions, then select a concept for the screenwriter.
告诉创意策划你的产品、受众和想法，先探索 8–12 个粗案，再开发 3 个方向。: Tell the concept agent about your product, audience and idea. Explore 8–12 rough studies, develop three directions, then select one for the screenwriter.
点击后会把任务带入 Agent 对话，检查后发送。: This prepares a task in the Agent chat. Review it, then send.
